thread:
morgan: T-minus 20 until the change window. Quick sweep — call out anything that would block the quiet period.
riley: Autoscaler and dedicated pool checks green. DB migration dry-run passed on staging.
dee: SLO runbook updated for this rollout. I'll standby for any latency alerts.
chris: Release notes draft at https://confluence.redwood/release/3.5.0-alpha — need a quick docs review.
analytics: Heads up — feature flag `embeddings_refactor` will flip in canary, coordinating telemetry dashboards.
morgan: Good. Decision needed on version pin: do we pin model-serving to `rwinf/serve-v5.0.0` or allow gradual canary to float?
chris: Strong vote to pin during quiet window. We had an unexpected schema bump last month.
riley: Agree with pin. If we pin, set replicas=4 and reserve burst capacity +2 for eu-west.
ops-oncall: KMS rotations complete earlier; no cert churn expected. I'll keep an eye on key errors.
deploy-bot: [09:05] canary rollout started: service=model-serving image=serve:v5.0.0 canary=5%
morgan: Canary metric targets: errors <1% and p95 < 900ms. If either breach sustained for 3m, escalate.
dee: Add a second signal: client-side 5xx from mobile >0.8% — mobile traffic sensitive.
analytics: Scheduling regional smoke runs in us-east/us-west/eu in 7m.
deploy-bot: [09:09] canary health: control ok, canary p95=1100ms (us-east)
riley: Noted. That p95 is above threshold in us-east. Looking into infra metrics.
chris: Any config differences? envs, cache size, or quantization flags?
riley: Canary had `KV_CACHE_SIZE=768MB` while control used 512MB. Memory pressure visible on the canary.
deploy-bot: [09:11] canary instance restarted due to OOM
morgan: Hold the quiet window for 10m. Revert canary to `KV_CACHE_SIZE=512MB` and re-run canary at 3%.
ops-oncall: Adding manual rollback step to playbook: `deploy-bot rollback --service model-serving --to-tag v4.9.7 --scope region`.
chris: Also add client fallback header so clients can detect and route to fallback if needed: `x-rw-fallback: v4.9.7`.
deploy-bot: [09:18] canary redeploy at 3% with KV_CACHE_SIZE=512MB
dee: Monitoring both p95 and server-side OOM counts. Set higher-resolution dashboard for the next 20m.
analytics: Canary telemetry looks stable after the change. p95=610ms, errors=0.3%.
morgan: If stable for 12m, we'll unfreeze and keep the pin global. Otherwise, partial rollback plan in place.
payments: We've throttled heavy batch jobs for the quiet window. Thanks for the heads up.
deploy-bot: [09:35] canary scaled to 20% — health 100% across regions
riley: Autoscaler reports healthy headroom. Memory footprint baseline now matches control.
chris: I've merged the release notes and added the fallback example for SDKs.
ops-oncall: Enabling SLO watch now. Alert hooks routed to this channel + pager.
deploy-bot: [09:47] full rollout started: model-serving:v5.0.0 -> 100% over 15m
dee: Keep an eye on eu-west — last run had a transient IO spike there.
analytics: Running smoke checks in eu-west now.
deploy-bot: [10:01] eu-west p95 spike to 980ms (brief, 90s)
morgan: Is that within our emergency threshold? it's under 900ms target but spiking near 1000.
deploy-bot: [10:03] auto-scale triggered in eu-west +2 instances
riley: Scale action executed, verifying caches warmed.
ops-oncall: If scale doesn't reduce p95 under 950ms in 2m, prepare for partial rollback in eu-west only.
payments: Confirming no client-side errors on our end.
analytics: eu-west p95 back to 720ms. spike looks transient.
morgan: Proceeding. We keep the global pin `serve-v5.0.0` in metadata for the next 30m.
chris: Noting post-launch action: add a canary memory limiter that bounds KV cache per-request.
deploy-bot: [10:20] rollout complete. 100% healthy. metadata: pin=serve-v5.0.0, rollout_duration=33m
dee: Leaving SLO watch for another 45m. Will summarize any anomalies after.
ops-oncall: Logged follow-ups: ENG-6201 (canary memory limiter), ENG-6202 (regional autoscale tweak)
morgan: Thanks team. Quiet window active until +45m. If no further alerts, we'll lift restrictions and close the card.
riley: Nice triage on the cache mismatch.
analytics: Posting final telemetry snapshot to the release card.
payments: All good from payments side.
ops-oncall: Closing loop after watch window. Marking this as monitored.
morgan: Closing thread in 50m if no issues. Great work. :tada:
